campaigns.core_idea: Own the framing that no Eid gathering is complete without a proper dessert table -- position Velvet Crumbs as the default source for Eid gifting boxes and celebration cakes before competitors claim it.
campaigns.target_audience_angle: Families and hosts across DHA, Clifton, Gulshan, and Bahria Town planning Eid gatherings and gifting weeks in advance -- people who default to whichever bakery is fastest to book, not necessarily the best.

execution_directions.direction: Open early-bird pre-orders for a curated Eid Gifting Box, limited slots per day as Eid approaches.
execution_directions.why_it_works: Creates urgency and reserves production capacity before the last-minute rush competitors will be scrambling to meet.

execution_directions.direction: A short Instagram Reel/Carousel series showing the gifting box being packed and gifted, building toward a countdown.
execution_directions.why_it_works: Gifting boxes are inherently visual and shareable -- the format sells itself if shown, not just described.

campaigns.core_idea: Reframe Velvet Crumbs from an occasion-cake shop to the default order for anytime people are gathering -- starting with PSL watch parties, where dessert isn't the obvious choice yet.
campaigns.target_audience_angle: Groups of friends and family hosting or attending PSL watch parties who already order snacks in -- an audience not currently thinking 'cake' but easily could.

execution_directions.direction: A same-day-order Match Night Dessert Box in team colors, sized for sharing during a match.
execution_directions.why_it_works: Low production complexity (mini bento cakes, simple icing) makes a same-day turnaround realistic without straining the kitchen.

execution_directions.direction: WhatsApp broadcast to repeat customers on match days with a hard ordering cutoff time.
execution_directions.why_it_works: Reaches an existing warm audience directly rather than relying on organic reach on match day.

campaigns.core_idea: Claim cake as rainy-day comfort food -- a space currently owned entirely by chai and samosas -- with a weather-triggered, limited-run flavor.
campaigns.target_audience_angle: Anyone staying in on a rare rainy Karachi day, craving something warm and indulgent delivered rather than gone out for.

execution_directions.direction: A limited chai-spice bento cake, promoted only when it's actually raining -- posted in the moment, not planned days ahead.
execution_directions.why_it_works: Weather-triggered content reads as authentic and timely rather than a generic seasonal push, and the novelty (cake as comfort food) is the hook.
